Candlestick patterns

Patterns of one to three candles that can point to a short-term change of direction or to indecision.

  • Bullish Engulfing

    • Candlestick pattern
    • ↑ Bullish reversal
    • 2 candles

    A reversal pattern that forms after a decline, when a large green candle completely engulfs the body of the previous red candle.

  • Bearish Engulfing

    • Candlestick pattern
    • ↓ Bearish reversal
    • 2 candles

    A reversal pattern that forms after a rise, when a large red candle completely engulfs the body of the previous green candle.

  • Piercing Line

    • Candlestick pattern
    • ↑ Bullish reversal
    • 2 candles

    A two-candle reversal pattern that forms after a decline, when a green candle closes above the middle of the previous large red candle's body.

  • Dark Cloud Cover

    • Candlestick pattern
    • ↓ Bearish reversal
    • 2 candles

    A two-candle reversal pattern that forms after a rise, when a red candle closes below the middle of the previous large green candle's body.

  • Bullish Harami

    • Candlestick pattern
    • ↑ Bullish reversal
    • 2 candles

    A reversal pattern that forms after a decline, when a large red candle is followed by a small green candle whose body sits entirely inside the red body.

  • Bearish Harami

    • Candlestick pattern
    • ↓ Bearish reversal
    • 2 candles

    A reversal pattern that forms after a rise, when a large green candle is followed by a small red candle whose body sits entirely inside the green body.

  • Hammer

    • Candlestick pattern
    • ↑ Bullish reversal
    • Single candle

    A single-candle reversal pattern that forms after a decline, with a small body and a long lower wick.

  • Hanging Man

    • Candlestick pattern
    • ↓ Bearish reversal
    • Single candle

    A single-candle reversal pattern that forms after a rise, with a small body and a long lower wick.

  • Inverted Hammer

    • Candlestick pattern
    • ↑ Bullish reversal
    • Single candle

    A single-candle reversal pattern that forms after a decline, with a small body and a long upper wick.

  • Shooting Star

    • Candlestick pattern
    • ↓ Bearish reversal
    • Single candle

    A single-candle reversal pattern that forms after a rise, with a small body and a long upper wick.

  • Pin Bar

    • Candlestick pattern
    • Reversal either way
    • Single candle

    A single-candle reversal pattern made of one long wick and a small body.

  • Doji

    • Candlestick pattern
    • Indecision
    • Single candle

    A single candle whose open and close are almost the same, leaving a very small body.

  • Spinning Top

    • Candlestick pattern
    • Indecision
    • Single candle

    A single candle with a small but visible body and wicks of similar length on both sides.

  • Morning Star

    • Candlestick pattern
    • ↑ Bullish reversal
    • 3 candles

    A three-candle reversal pattern that forms after a decline.

  • Evening Star

    • Candlestick pattern
    • ↓ Bearish reversal
    • 3 candles

    A three-candle reversal pattern that forms after a rise.
